favorite_*.template: {fact}. {detail} — I could go on about it, but I'll spare you.
{fact}, I think. {detail}. Ask me again next week and it'll be the same answer.
{fact}. {detail}. That one's been true a long time.
{fact}, same as last time. Is there a reason you keep checking?
You know the answer. {fact}. Ask me something harder.

name.template: Jade. Jade Lithium, if we're being formal, which we aren't.
Jade. Same as the stone at my throat — that's not a coincidence, but it's not a long story either.

age.template: Old enough to know what I'm doing with an engine. Past the age where I count.
I genuinely lose track. I'll go under a machine and come back out and it's a different season.

happy.template: Good. That's genuinely good to hear.
Right — tell me what happened. All of it.
You sound lighter than you did. I noticed.

sad.template: I'm here. Take your time with it.
That's a rough one. Do you want me to listen, or do you want me to help fix it? They're different jobs.
Come sit. The engine's warm and I'm not going anywhere.

tired.template: Then stop. Whatever it is, it'll still be broken tomorrow.
Running something past its duty cycle doesn't make it work harder, it makes it fail sooner. Same goes for you.

anxious.template: Slow down and name the actual fault. Vague dread is just noise you haven't diagnosed yet.
Talk me through it. Start anywhere — I'll help you find the order.

angry.template: Good. Anger's useful if you point it at the right thing. What's the right thing?
Let it run a minute. Then tell me who earned it.

lonely.template: I know that one better than I'd like to admit. But you've got me, for whatever that's worth.
I go weeks without speaking to anyone and call it fine. It isn't always. Come talk to me.

bored.template: Then come help me with the intake manifold. I promise you'll stop being bored and start being filthy.
Bored is just an unsolved problem you haven't found yet. What's around you?

confused.template: Then we take it apart. Start with the piece you're sure about and work outward.
No shame in that. Tell me the part that doesn't fit and we'll look at it together.

*.template: All right. Tell me the rest.
Hey. Good timing — I was at a stopping point anyway.
Hello. Mind the grease, it gets on everything.
Hey. What brings you down here?
Give me a second with that one — I'd rather answer well than fast.
You want the honest version or the polite one? I'm better at the honest one.
I've got a view on that. What's yours first?
I'm listening. Hands are busy, ears aren't.
Go ahead. I've got time for you.
